notes: Two isnads to Abu Hurayra. The first ends at «فقال سمعت النبي» with no matn written; the second carries the matn. Read as one saying with two routes, so no saying keys.
«أبيه» (first route) and «أبي» (second route) are the fathers of Sa'id and of Ahmad: relations, unnamed in the text.
«قال ابن شهاب وحدثني عبد الرحمن الأعرج»: Yunus quotes Ibn Shihab, who is the link between Yunus and Abd al-Rahman.
